title: 第五卷四十一落鳞第五卷四十龙族之盟誓
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：鲤印记正文第五卷（四十一）落鳞（..la）结盟仪式结束后第三天，东山谷的喧闹终于慢慢沉寂下来。各国使节的飞船一艘接一艘地离开，泊位上的巨型灵石指示灯从满排的红光变回零星的几点绿。玉米地被踩歪的那几垄，紫灵带着五姐妹一棵一棵地扶正了。老刀蹲在田埂上，看着重新站直的玉米秆，剥了一粒玉米放进嘴里，说了一句“快熟了”，也不知道是在说玉米还是在说别的什么。
颜丙没有走。他的理由很充分——小金龙还没有完全融合，归尘网丝做桥需要等清澜灵力恢复到最佳状态，龙族与联邦的军事协作细节还需要进一步磋商。每个理由都站得住脚，每个理由都不是真的。真正的原因他藏在心里，连自己都不太敢翻出来细看。那个＂原因＂穿着一身素色束腰长裙，手腕上系着一根红绳，说话时睫毛会微微垂下，瞳孔周围有一圈极淡的金色虹膜。他四千多岁了，见过鸿蒙初开时的第一缕光，见过高维宇宙崩塌时的最后一场雨，见过无数星辰诞生和熄灭。他从来没有想过，自己有一天会因为一个三十多岁的姑娘而不敢照镜子。理智告诉他该走了，可是他现在不想明白理智是对的。
霓涟也没有走。她的理由也很充分——五姐妹中她最年长，龙族与联邦情报部的对接工作理应由她负责，黯和清澜那边也需要有人盯着小金龙融合归尘网丝的进展。每个理由都经得起推敲，每个理由都不是真的。每个理由又都是真的。
第四天傍晚。
东山谷的夕阳是紫色的，紫月星特有的蓝色太阳落山时会和大气层里的灵石微粒产生折射，把整片天空染成深浅不一的紫。霓涟站在玉米地边上，手里拿着一份情报部刚传来的数据板，但她一个字也没看进去。她在等一个人。那个人每天黄昏都会来这片玉米地散步——这也是她时时刻刻关注他发现的，身为情报官，收集目标对象的活动规律是基本功。只是这一次，她自己也不确定自己算不算在“执行任务”。
颜丙来了。他远远看见她的背影，脚步顿了一下。以他的修为，转身离开可以不发出任何声音，可以在她没有察觉之前消失得无影无踪。理智让他走，但他却继续往前，每一步都踩得很稳，每一步都似乎在跟自己较劲。
“颜丙前辈。”霓涟终于转过身，语气平稳，表情克制，数据板拿在手里纹丝不动。情报部精英的素养在这一刻发挥到了极致——她的声音没有任何异常，心跳没有任何异常，灵力波动没有任何异常。但她忘了：自己的竖瞳藏不起来。那双瞳孔周围的金色虹膜在紫色的夕阳下散发着仙族特有的瑰丽。
颜丙看着她的眼睛，忘了自己要说什么。过了好几息，他本想说我路过这里，可开口却是：“霓涟姑娘。在这里等我？”
“没有。”她回答得太快，快得像情报部最利落的特工在执行任务汇报，“我在看玉米。东山谷的玉米是紫灵前辈种的，这种品种对灵力波动的感知非常敏感，龙族进驻后地脉灵力发生变化，我需要评估这种变化对本地农作物的影响。”她把数据板抬起来给他看，上面密密麻麻全是灵力波动监测数据，表格工整，图表清晰，确实是一份标准的情报分析报告。
颜丙低头看着那份报告，嘴角微微弯起。他只是轻轻说了一句：“这份数据你上午已经发给联邦农业部了。”
霓涟的耳根眨眼间红得像被火烧了一样。她把数据板放下来，转过身去，用背影对着他。这一转身是最明显的破绽——情报部最基本的原则是从来不会把背影留给近前的任何人，但她把背影留给了他。
“你说得对，我是在等你。”
颜丙的心似乎已经停止跳动。四千年的龙了。
霓涟没有转回来。她的背影很瘦，灵蛇一族的骨架比人类更纤细，她的肩膀在暮色里显得格外单薄。但就是这个单薄的背影，此刻站得笔直，像是在面对此生最重要的问卷。
“我不确定我为什么要这么说，但我还是想告诉你——从霸王星回来之后，我每次闭上眼睛，眼前出现的不是数据，不是情报，是．．．”
风突然变大，吹过玉米地，叶子沙沙地响，正好盖过了涟最后一个字。颜丙没有说话。不是不想说，是被那句“是．．”击中了某个极其脆弱的地方——他活了数千年，被人敬畏过、崇拜过、憎恨过、遗忘过，从来没有被人这样轻轻地说过“是．．”这个字的重量，像混沌边缘的暴风雪。
“霓涟。”他的声音涩得像含着一口最烈的酒：“我今年四千多岁。”
霓涟转过身来看着他。她的竖瞳在紫色暮光里亮得惊人。
“我知道。你跟我说过了。”
“你母亲霓依才一千多岁。你的外婆霓纯烟——”颜丙闭了一下眼睛，再睁开时眼底全是血丝：“她四十二岁的时候，在混沌边缘的雪原上蜕第一次皮，我在旁边替她护的法。她按辈分要叫我一声前辈。可你现在站在这里，跟我说你闭上眼睛看见的是我。”

霓涟没有退缩。情报官的本能让她从不回避任何残酷的信息。她只是问了一句话，但这句话像是风吹过船上巨帆，瞬间就改变了一切：“所以呢？”
“所以．．”颜丙往后退了一步，这一步退得很小，但他是在后退——龙族族长，面对任何敌人都没有退过半步，此刻面对一个比自己小了接近四千岁的姑娘，他退了。“我经历过的东西，是你无法想象的，而且你可能有点误会了，我喜欢你只是因为欣赏。”
霓涟看着他。她的竖瞳里那圈金色虹膜渐渐暗了下去，取而代之的是一层极薄的水光。她没有让水光溢出来，灵蛇很少流泪，流泪会蜕皮，蜕皮会变弱。她不能在他面前变弱。她说了一句她这辈子说过的最大胆的话。
“你说了很多，没有一句是不喜欢我。你只是觉得自己不配。可我不要你觉得配。我只要你告诉我——如果我不是霓涟，你不是颜丙，我没有三十多岁，你没有四千多岁，你会不会回头看我？”
颜丙攥紧了拳头，指节咔咔作响。龙族之力足以捏碎星辰，此刻却按不住自己心口那一阵比死还痛的悸动。他想说会——他当然会，这个答案就在他喉咙里，就在他每一次看见她的眼瞳就不敢用力呼吸、每一次看到她的背影就不想移开目光的瞬间里。但他说不出口。因为这不是两个在玉米地边上遇见的人，他是颜丙，她是霓涟。他四千岁，她三十岁。他说出口的不是告白，是另一句更残酷的实话。
“霓涟姑娘，我实在太老了，你实在太小了。”
霓涟眼眶里那层水光终于碎了。所以她只是站在那里，看着他，瞳孔里的金色虹膜彻底暗了下去。然后她转身走了，走得很稳，比来时更稳。走出玉米地，她的脚步声一下都没乱。
颜丙看着她的背影消失在田埂尽头。他没有追。他知道自己做了正确的决定——正确的决定从来不会让人痛到这种程度。正确到他想喝上一大杯，虽然他从不喝酒。他蹲下来，单膝跪在霓涟刚才站的地方，他把手按在那块土地上，闭上眼睛。
接下来三天，联邦总部有人慢慢发现了两件事。
第一件事，龙族族长瘦了。不是普通的瘦，是灵力凝聚了数千年的躯体在以肉眼可见的速度消减。颜丙依然每天准时出席军事协作磋商会议，依然用那温润如玉的声音和联邦将领讨论每一个细节，依然对所有与会者保持无可挑剔的礼貌。但清澜注意到，他面前那杯茶从来没人动过。东东趴在桌子底下，蓝眼睛盯着他那截露在袍角外面的手腕——腕骨突出来了，龙族的骨骼密度比灵石还高，能让龙族瘦到骨骼突出，那已经不是代谢问题，是某种意识在流失。
第二件事，霓涟的工作量翻了三倍。她主动接下了联邦情报部积压的所有繁杂任务——洛伦联邦边境巡逻数据汇总、斯威斯特星外交风险评估、铁壁星联合体语言破译，连档案室尘封多年的旧案卷宗都被她翻出来重新整理归档。霓漪说大姐每晚加班到凌晨三点，早餐只喝半杯水，问她她就说“不饿”。霓光说大姐的灵力波动频率降了接近两成，灵蛇的灵力波动和情绪状态直接相关，降两成意味着她的情绪在承受极大的消耗。霓影什么都没说，只是每天深夜在霓涟办公室门口放一杯热好的牛奶，第二天早上那杯牛奶原封不动。
第四天，霓涟请了病假。五姐妹和母亲霓依之间有灵蛇一族特有的心灵感应，她感应到了。霓依放下情报部的工作，找到了颜丙。这位情报部的实权人物平时深居简出，极少亲自出面和人谈话。此刻她坐在颜丙对面，开门见山。
“我女儿在阿尔法努星沈轻烟的宗门里。她不肯见我，也不肯见她的妹妹们。”颜丙低着头看着自己那只空了的茶杯。霓依的语气平静如水，“霓涟从小就是个特别有主见的孩子。她决定的事，我这个做母亲的也改变不了。所以她喜欢你这件事，我不是来兴师问罪的。我只是来问你一句：你推开她的时候，是真的不喜欢她，还是不敢喜欢她？”
“霓部长。”他开口，声音沙哑，像是几天没有沾过水——事实上他也确实几天没有沾过水，“我四千岁了。涟儿才三十出头。你母亲霓纯烟跟我同辈，我曾经做过很多错事，肩上扛着太多东西。这样一个年轻人，应该去遇到一个能和她并肩走一生的人。我不敢也不配。”
霓依没有说话。她静静地看了他很久，然后站起来，说了一句让颜丙彻夜无眠的话。
“颜丙，你说你活了很久，做的错事很多。可你在做错事的时候，有没有人给过你第二次机会？如果有，为什么你不给自己第二次机会？如果没有——那涟儿就是那个人。你在混沌边缘等了几千年，等的不是龙魂归位，是有人告诉你，你可以重新开始。”
她走了，留下颜丙一个人坐在空荡荡的会客厅里。窗外紫月星的月亮很亮，月光照在他手背上，手背上的骨骼轮廓比三天前更分明了。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Carp Seal Text Volume 5 (41) Falling Scales (..la) On the third day after the alliance ceremony, the noise in the East Valley finally slowly fell silent. The spaceships of envoys from various countries left one after another, and the giant spirit stone indicator lights on the berth changed from a full row of red light back to a few sporadic green lights. Zi Ling and the five sisters straightened the ridges in the cornfield that had been trampled one by one. Lao Dao squatted on the ridge of the field, looked at the corn stalks that had stood upright again, peeled a kernel of corn, put it in his mouth, and said, "It's almost ripe." He didn't know whether he was talking about the corn or something else.
Yan Bing did not leave. His reasons are very good - the little golden dragon has not yet fully integrated, the bridge made of Guichen mesh needs to wait until Qinglan's spiritual power returns to its optimal state, and the details of military cooperation between the Dragon Clan and the Federation need further negotiation. Every reason is valid, every reason is untrue. He hid the real reason in his heart, and even he didn't dare to dig it out and take a closer look. The "reason" was wearing a plain long skirt with a waist, and a red rope tied around her wrist. Her eyelashes would slightly droop when she spoke, and there was a very light golden irises around her pupils. He is more than four thousand years old. He has seen the first ray of light when the Hongmeng first opened, the last rain when the high-dimensional universe collapsed, and the birth and extinction of countless stars. He never thought that one day he would be afraid to look in the mirror because of a girl in her thirties. Reason told him that it was time to go, but now he didn't want to understand that reason was right.
Ni Lian didn't leave either. Her reasons are also very good - she is the eldest among the five sisters, and she should be responsible for the docking work between the Dragon Clan and the Federal Intelligence Department. An and Qinglan also need someone to keep an eye on the progress of the Little Golden Dragon's integration with the Guichen Web Silk. Every reason stands up to scrutiny, and every reason is untrue. Every reason is true.
In the evening of the fourth day.
The sunset in the East Valley is purple. When the purple moon star's unique blue sun sets, it will refract with the spirit stone particles in the atmosphere, dyeing the entire sky in different shades of purple. Ni Lian stood on the edge of the cornfield, holding in her hand a data pad that had just been sent from the Intelligence Department, but she didn't read a word of it. She is waiting for someone. That man would come to this cornfield for a walk every evening - this was what she discovered by paying close attention to him all the time. As an intelligence officer, collecting the target's activity patterns was a basic skill. Only this time, she wasn't sure whether she was "performing a mission."
Yan Bing is here. He saw her back from a distance and paused. With his cultivation, he could turn around and leave without making any sound, and he could disappear without a trace before she noticed. Reason told him to go, but he continued to move forward, taking every step firmly, and every step seemed to be competing with himself.
"Senior Yan Bing." Ni Lian finally turned around, with a calm tone and a restrained expression, holding the data pad motionless in his hand. The intelligence elite's qualities were brought to their fullest at this moment - there was nothing abnormal in her voice, her heartbeat was not abnormal, and her spiritual power fluctuations were not abnormal. But she forgot: her vertical pupils cannot be hidden. The golden irises around those pupils exude the splendor unique to the fairy clan under the purple sunset.
Yan Bing looked into her eyes and forgot what he was going to say. After a few breaths, he wanted to say that I was passing by, but instead he said, "Miss Ni Lian. Wait for me here?"
"No." She answered too quickly, as fast as the most agile agent of the Intelligence Department reporting on a mission. "I'm looking at the corn. The corn in the East Valley was grown by Senior Zi Ling. This variety is very sensitive to spiritual power fluctuations. After the Dragon Clan moved in, the earth's spiritual power changed. I need to evaluate the impact of this change on local crops." She lifted the data board and showed it to him. It was densely packed with spiritual power fluctuation monitoring data. The tables were neat and the charts were clear. It was indeed a standard intelligence analysis report.
Yan Bing looked down at the report, the corners of his mouth are slightly curved. He just said softly: "You have already sent this data to the Federal Ministry of Agriculture this morning."
Ni Lian's ears turned red in the blink of an eye, as if they were on fire. She put the dataslate down and turned around, facing him with her back. This turn was the most obvious flaw - the most basic principle of the Intelligence Department was to never leave your back to anyone in front of you, but she left her back to him.
"You're right, I'm waiting for you."
Yan Bing's heart seemed to have stopped beating. A four-thousand-year-old dragon.
Ni Lian did not turn back. Her back was very thin, the skeleton of the spirit snake clan was slender than that of humans, and her shoulders looked particularly thin in the dusk. But this thin figure stood upright at this moment, as if facing the most important questionnaire in his life.
"I'm not sure why I say this, but I still want to tell you - after coming back from Overlord, every time I close my eyes, what appears in front of me is not data or intelligence, but..."
The wind suddenly became stronger, blowing through the cornfield, and the leaves rustled, which just covered the last word "Lian". Yan Bing said nothing. It's not that he didn't want to say it, but that sentence "Yes..." hit an extremely vulnerable place - he had lived for thousands of years, and had been revered, worshiped, hated, and forgotten by others. He had never been spoken to so gently by someone. The weight of the word "Yes..." was like a blizzard on the edge of chaos.
"Ni Lian." His voice was as bitter as a sip of the strongest wine: "I am over four thousand years old this year."
Ni Lian turned around and looked at him. Her vertical pupils were astonishingly bright in the purple twilight.
"I know. You told me."
"Your mother Ni Yi is only over a thousand years old. Your grandmother Ni Chunyan -" Yan Bing closed his eyes, and when he opened them again, his eyes were full of bloodshot eyes: "When she was forty-two years old, she shed her skin for the first time on the snowfield on the edge of chaos. I was there to protect her. She wanted to call me senior according to her seniority. But you stand here now and tell me that it is me you see when you close your eyes."
Ni Lian didn't flinch. Her instinct as an intelligence officer never shied away from any harsh information. She just asked one sentence, but it was like the wind blowing through the huge sail on the ship, changing everything in an instant: "So?"
"So..." Yan Bing took a step back. This step was very small, but he was retreating - the leader of the Dragon Clan had never taken a step back when facing any enemy. At this moment, facing a girl who was nearly four thousand years younger than him, he retreated. "The things I have experienced are beyond your imagination, and you may have misunderstood a little. I like you just because of appreciation."
Ni Lian looked at him. The golden irises in her vertical pupils gradually dimmed, replaced by a very thin layer of water. She did not let the water spill out. The spiritual snake rarely sheds tears. If it sheds tears, it will shed its skin, and the shed skin will become weaker. She couldn't become weak in front of him. She said the boldest thing she had ever said in her life.
"You have said a lot, but not a single word means that you don't like me. You just feel that you are not worthy. But I don't want you to feel worthy. I just want you to tell me - if I were not Ni Lian, you were not Yan Bing, I was not over thirty years old, and you were not over four thousand years old, would you look back at me?"
Yan Bing clenched his fists and cracked his knuckles. The power of the dragon clan is enough to crush the stars, but at this moment, he can't hold back the throbbing in his heart that is more painful than death. He wanted to say yes - of course he would, the answer was in his throat, in the moment when he didn't dare to breathe hard every time he saw her eyes, and didn't want to look away every time he saw her back. But he couldn't say it. Because these are not two people who met on the edge of a cornfield. He is Yan Bing and she is Ni Lian. He is four thousand years old and she is thirty. What he said was not a confession, but another, crueler truth.
"Miss Ni Lian, I am too old and you are too young."
The layer of water in Ni Lian's eyes finally shattered. So she just stood there, looking at him, the golden irises in his pupils darkened completely. Then she turned and walked away, walking steadily, more steadily than when she came. Walking out of the cornfield, her footsteps were not disturbed at all.
Yan Bing watched her figure disappear at the end of the field. He didn't chase. He knew he made the right decision—the right decision never hurt this bad. So correct that he wanted to have a big drink, even though he never drank. He squatted down and knelt on one knee where Ni Lian had just been standing. He put his hand on the piece of land and closed his eyes.
In the next three days, someone at the federal headquarters slowly discovered two things.
The first thing is that the leader of the Dragon Clan has lost weight. It's not just ordinary thinness, it's the body whose spiritual power has been condensed for thousands of years that is diminishing at a speed visible to the naked eye. Yan Bing still attended military cooperation consultation meetings on time every day, still used his gentle voice to discuss every detail with federal generals, and still remained impeccably polite to all participants. But Qinglan noticed that the cup of tea in front of him had never been touched. Dongdong was lying under the table, his blue eyes staring at his wrist that was exposed outside the corner of his robe - the wrist bone was protruding. The dragon's bone density is higher than that of the spirit stone, which can make the dragon so thin that the bones protrude. This is no longer a metabolic problem, but a loss of some kind of consciousness.
The second thing was that Ni Lian's workload tripled. She took the initiative to take over all the complex tasks backlogged by the Federal Intelligence Department - the collection of Loren federal border patrol data, the diplomatic risk assessment of Swiste, and the deciphering of the Ironwall Federation language. She even dug out the old case files that had been dusty for many years in the archives and reorganized them. Niyi said that her eldest sister worked overtime until three in the morning every night and only drank half a glass of water for breakfast. When asked, she said "not hungry." Niguang said that the frequency of the elder sister's spiritual power fluctuations dropped by nearly 20%. The spiritual power fluctuations of the spirit snake were directly related to her emotional state. A drop of 20% meant that her emotions were under great consumption. Ni Ying didn't say anything, he just put a cup of hot milk at the door of Ni Lian's office late every night, and the cup of milk remained intact the next morning.
On the fourth day, Ni Lian took sick leave. There is a telepathy unique to the spirit snake clan between the five sisters and their mother Niyi, and she senses it. Niyi put down her work in the intelligence department and found Yan Bing. This powerful figure in the Ministry of Intelligence usually keeps to himself and rarely talks to people in person. At this moment, she was sitting opposite Yan Bing and got straight to the point.
"My daughter is in Shen Qingyan's sect on Alfanu star. She refuses to see me, nor her sisters." Yan Bing lowered his head and looked at his empty tea cup. Ni Yi's tone was as calm as water, "Ni Lian has been a very independent child since she was a child. As a mother, I can't change what she decides. So I'm not here to accuse her of liking you. I'm just here to ask you: when you pushed her away, did you really not like her, or did you dare not like her?"
"Minister Ni." He said, his voice hoarse, as if he hadn't been exposed to water for several days - in fact, he had not been exposed to water for several days. "I am four thousand years old. Lian'er is only in her early thirties. Your mother, Ni Chunyan, is of the same generation as me. I have done many wrong things and carried too many things on my shoulders. Such a young man should meet someone who can walk his life side by side with her. I dare not and am not worthy."
Niyi said nothing. She looked at him quietly for a long time, then stood up and said something that made Yan Bing sleepless all night.
"Yan Bing, you said that you have lived for a long time and done many wrong things. But when you did wrong things, did anyone give you a second chance? If so, why didn't you give yourself a second chance? If not - then Lian'er is that person. You have been waiting on the edge of chaos for thousands of years, not for the return of the dragon soul, but for someone to tell you that you can start over."
She left, leaving Yan Bing sitting alone in the empty living room. The moon on the Purple Moon Star outside the window is very bright. The moonlight shines on the back of his hand, and the outline of the bones on the back of his hand.It's clearer than three days ago.
